mainEntity.name: What are common surprises uncovered during a whole-home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hidden issues can include outdated wiring, undersized or damaged plumbing, structural deficiencies, moisture damage, inadequate insulation, and previous unpermitted work that must be brought up to code.
